title: Beams, Echoes and Spectra — From wartime navigation and radar to particle accelerators and software-defined radio
description: A talk on the intertwined history of radar, telecommunications and particle accelerators — from Bragg's sound-ranging and Widerøe's RF accelerator through the "Battle of the Beams", radar, magnetrons and klystrons — and on what it means today: many fields still solve closely related problems (timing, filtering, coherent detection, feedback, spectral estimation, control) with different terminology and tools. The deck is a gr4-present presentation whose live acoustic demonstrations run GNU Radio 4 and OpenDigitizer flow-graphs in the browser.
